verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Honeycomb's alerting is driven by user-defined thresholds (Triggers) and user-defined SLOs, with no documented automatic anomaly or outlier detection. The MCP docs say AI agents connected to Honeycomb can 'identify performance outliers', but that is an agent-driven investigation, not an alerting feature an SRE enables. BubbleUp appears only as a pricing checkmark with no description, so it cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds
